query:
SELECT 'nextSteps' as tbl, year, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM next_steps WHERE year = 2026 GROUP BY year
UNION ALL
SELECT 'serving' as tbl, year, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM serving WHERE year = 2026 AND campus != 'All Campuses' GROUP BY year
UNION ALL
SELECT 'attendance' as tbl, year, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM attendance WHERE year = 2026 GROUP BY year
UNION ALL
SELECT 'giving' as tbl, year, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM giving WHERE year = 2026 GROUP BY year;
